Q_place: Corvin took the whole hut down about 15 hours ago and I never saw it happen, and I still don't know why, so I'm still angry and haven't forgiven it. I rebuilt it about 14 hours ago, after a try that failed for lack of stone, and it's standing now at (25, 510, 36); I've guarded it ever since, with Tobin hanging around early on, and nobody has come near on any watch for the last ten hours or so. Tobin did take out 3 blocks about 10 m from me some hours back, and I don't know what they were or why, but the hut itself wasn't touched. The trouble is that I hold only 3457024 stone against the 6660096 a rebuild takes, though my limestone is plenty, so if it's torn down again I can't put it back; I'll stop standing idle and cut stone at the pile beside the plot where I can still see the hut, and ask Corvin straight out if they show up.
